reviewer: Assistant visual inspection of fresh589 images

window.edge: Entrance, lamps, path, fence and trees remain fixed; independent scene ROI has zero changed pixels
window.arrow: Entrance leaves view; lamp path reaches left boundary and trees/fence shift together
window.drag: Lamp path returns into lower-left view; trees and fence shift coherently

full.edge: Lamp path leaves view; diagonal fence and trees shift into view
full.arrow: Fence shifts toward upper-left and tree landmarks move coherently
full.drag: Fence shifts back diagonally through lower view; trees move coherently

stages: Full Screen 640x480 options in passive display frame
Restored Window options with edge-scroll enabled
limits: PC observations only. No Xbox scrolling, RCT save persistence, FPS, acceleration or sound qualification. Window-edge nonmovement is an observed result, not a demonstrated driver defect.
